<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Claude"> <diagram name="System Design" id="url-shortener-system-design"> <mxGraphModel dx="2339" dy="240" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1169" pageHeight="826" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 subgraph Client
 U[User]
 end

 subgraph Infrastructure
 LB[Load Balancer]
 AG[API Gateway]
 RL[Rate Limiter]
 end

 subgraph Services
 US[URL Shortener Service]
 AS[Analytics Service]
 BJ[Background Jobs]
 end

 subgraph Storage
 RD[(Redis Cache)]
 DB[(SQL Database)]
 ADB[(Analytics DB)]
 end

 subgraph Async
 MQ[Message Queue - Kafka]
 end

 U --> LB --> AG --> RL --> US

 US --> V{Valid URL?}
 V -- No --> Err[400 Bad Request]
 V -- Yes --> EX{Check Existing?}
 EX -- Yes --> Ret[Return Existing]
 EX -- No --> Gen[Generate Unique ID]
 Gen --> B62[Base62 Encode]
 B62 --> Store[Store in Redis & SQL]
 Store --> Ret

 US --> GET{GET /{code}}
 GET --> Cache{Redis Hit?}
 Cache -- Yes --> Redir[301/302 Redirect]
 Cache -- No --> DBQ[Query SQL DB]
 DBQ --> Found{Found?}
 Found -- No --> NF[404 Not Found]
 Found -- Yes --> Upd[Update Redis]
 Upd --> Redir

 Redir -->|Async Event| MQ
 MQ --> AS
 AS --> ADB
 BJ -->|Cleanup| DB
 DB -.->|Replication| DB_Repl[(SQL Replica)]

 style RD fill:#f9f,stroke:#333
 style DB fill:#ddd,stroke:#333
 style ADB fill:#ddd,stroke:#333
 style MQ fill:#ff9,stroke:#333
 style US fill:#bbf,stroke:#333
 style AS fill:#bbf,stroke:#333
 style BJ fill:#bfb,stroke:#333
 style V fill:#fff4dd,stroke:#d4a017
 style EX fill:#fff4dd,stroke:#d4a017
 style Cache fill:#fff4dd,stroke:#d4a017
 style Found fill:#fff4dd,stroke:#d4a017
 style Err fill:#fdd,stroke:#a00
 style NF fill:#fdd,stroke:#a00",
 "config": null
